0022600158.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder visit the Cleveland Cavaliers with both teams at 4-2 through six games, but the Thunder are 1-2 on the road and on a two-game losing streak, while the Cavaliers are 3-0 at home and have won their last game. Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson, who is day-to-day with hamstring soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently beating Cleveland 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
